events.title: A New Look at the World of Silicone Heart
events.summary: We've updated the Steam gallery with new screenshots and an atmospheric GIF that better captures the game's vibe. Piece by piece, the world is coming together as we envisioned: • A planet transformed into a giant scrapyard. • Unique robots whose dialogues and actions are shaped by their past. • Bridges and shelters woven from the remains of a colossal machine.
